summary: `href()` now stringifies and URL-encodes param values (splats encoded per segment), matching `generatePath()`, instead of interpolating them raw.
`href()` and `generatePath()` encode path params with RFC 3986 path-segment rules instead of `encodeURIComponent`, so `$ & + , ; = : @` stay literal (`1.0.0+1` no longer becomes `1.0.0%2B1`).
The `createStaticRouter({ branches })` option is deprecated: it is ignored with a warning (branches are cached internally), and `EntryContext.branches` is now always an empty array.

The exported `UNSAFE_DataRouterStateContext` no longer holds the full `RouterState`; loader/action data and pending navigation state move to the new `UNSAFE_DataRouterDataContext` and `UNSAFE_DataRouterNavigationContext`.

React Router's view transition APIs are deprecated in favor of React 19.3's `<ViewTransition>`: the `viewTransition` prop/option on `Link`, `NavLink`, `Form`, `navigate`/`submit`, `useViewTransitionState`, and `NavLink`'s `isTransitioning` render prop and `transitioning` class.
